{{Quote|I wouldn't trust Jedi farsight all that much if I were you. The Emperor did a lot of that, too. It didn't help him much in the end&hellip;|Mara Jade|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
'''Farsight''' (also called '''clairvoyance''', '''far sight''' or '''farseeing''') was the [[Force power/Legends|ability]] requiring training in the Control and Sense skills. [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] employing farsight were able to see visions of people or places in their mind, as it appeared at the same time they were observing. The visions included the immediate surroundings, allowing the Force user to determine if a friend was in danger, or what had occurred on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in their absence.<ref name="RPG" />

[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] used this skill to discover that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was in danger after his [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|fight]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="SW:RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> He also used it to set his traps for the Jedi, keeping himself several steps ahead. During a meeting aboard the Death Star, when Vader told Admiral [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] to not place too much faith in the Death Star's capabilities and implied even its destructive power was insignificant compared to the power of the [[Cosmic Force/Legends|Cosmic Force]], Motti insubordinately retorted that Vader's devotion to the Force didn't have him find the stolen [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] while sarcastically referring to such as clairvoyance before Vader nearly choked him.<ref name="SW:ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref><ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref>

One of the first Force powers [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] taught to the young [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was farseeing. He used this ability to sense that his friends were in danger on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Despite the advice of Yoda and the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of Obi-Wan Kenobi, he decided to intervene.<ref name="SW:TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

[[File:Far_Sight.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] viewing herself and [[Dark Mara]] through farseeing]]
